digest.component_or_area: Cloud/Jira adapter resilience and config validation
propositions: Cloud transport methods lack enumerated per-member 429 retry coverage across four distinct retry boundaries (pooled REST, bare urlopen, subprocess, dispatch wrapper), allowing undocumented retry paths and duplicate-write risks.
Cloud lacks config-validation tier to reject non-HTTPS URLs, fail loudly on missing credentials, and make resolved-status set runtime-configurable, creating parity gap with DC.

Cloud's urllib.error.HTTPError handling differs across seams: direct REST does not retry, subprocess intentionally retries via rate-limit backoff, dispatch wrapper retries 429s, and apply-phases do not retry, requiring per-layer assertions.
Cloud's hardcoded RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES in probe.py does not support per-deployment resolved-status workflow customization available in DC via reconciler.resolved_statuses config.
